symptom: re-executing the unchanged `describe layout` of a Studio Pro-authored layout reported "Replaced" and rewrote the unit, moving its canvas to 1280 × 800
cause: layoutToGen writes CanvasWidth/CanvasHeight as constants and UpdateLayout carried nothing, while every one of PedApp's 22 Atlas layouts stores another canvas (1198, 1204, 1000, 800, 550, 500 × 600)
insight: The third document kind with the same defect: pages (#541) and snippets (#705) were fixed one at a time and layouts were missed, because each writer has its own constant-header block. When an editor-only property is carried for one document kind, grep the other writers for the same constant. Proved at the storage layer (unchanged rewrite keeps the unit byte-identical; fails with the carry removed) because Atlas layouts are in a marketplace module exec refuses to write
